title: Read a mapping value
summary: Solidity: Read a mapping value. Call another unused key.
introduction: A mapping pairs keys with values. Unset integer keys return zero. Call scoreOf(1).
learningObjectives: Read a mapping value with Solidity

blocks.text: Paste one contract into Remix and choose compiler 0.8.24 or later in the 0.8 series. Deploy only to Remix VM for practice. Call the function named in the lesson; shown results are return values.

blocks.title: Read a mapping value

blocks.text: No entry was written for key 1. The uint256 default is zero.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A zero result does not tell you whether a key was ever written.
